combine: mean of softmax probabilities; each member averages the image and its horizontal flip
training: each member = final fit on ALL 2,612 images of edithstark/solar-ai-web-condition-v2-clean (Kaggle T4), fixed epochs, no early stopping

oof_estimate.protocol: 5-fold family-grouped CV, mean of these 2 members' out-of-fold probabilities. The pair was chosen for cost (cheapest strong pair) after seeing OOF scores, so treat as mildly optimistic.

cost: ~1.2 s per panel crop on 4 CPU threads of a desktop CPU (with flip TTA); about 3x cheaper than the full 5-model ensemble
status: RESEARCH ONLY - trained on web photos; never validated on the target rooftop camera; not for alerts
